  <!-- JAVASCRIPT LOGIC -->
  <script>
    // SafeStorage Engine - Discrete Safe wrapper anti SecurityError pada Google Apps Script (GAS) Sandbox
    var SafeStorage = {
      _data: {},
      getItem: function(key) {
        try {
          return window.localStorage.getItem(key);
        } catch (e) {
          return this._data[key] || null;
        }
      },
      setItem: function(key, val) {
        try {
          window.localStorage.setItem(key, val);
        } catch (e) {
          this._data[key] = String(val);
        }
      },
      removeItem: function(key) {
        try {
          window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
        } catch (e) {
          delete this._data[key];
        }
      },
      clear: function() {
        try {
          window.localStorage.clear();
        } catch (e) {
          this._data = {};
        }
      }
    };

    // Global App Configuration
    var AppConfig = {
      totalStudents: 248,

      lampiranMpls: { label: "Lampiran Kerja", subtitle: "PDF - Lembar Refleksi", icon: "fa-paperclip", color: "text-purple-600 bg-purple-500/20" }
    };

    // Simulator Local Fallback Engine (Digunakan jika server-side GAS belum dikonfigurasi)
    function simulateGasRun(funcName, ...args) {
      if (funcName === 'loginUser') {
        const [username, password] = args;
        if (username === 'admin' && (password === 'admin' || password === 'Admin@2026')) {
          return { success: true, token: "session-token-123" };
        } else {
          return { success: false, message: "Kombinasi Username/Password salah!" };
        }
      } else if (funcName === 'getPublicCommitments' || funcName === 'getCommitments') {
        return { success: true, data: JSON.parse(SafeStorage.getItem("MPLS_COMMITMENTS") || "[]") };
      } else if (funcName === 'addCommitmentPublic') {
        const [name, cls, text] = args;
        const list = JSON.parse(SafeStorage.getItem("MPLS_COMMITMENTS") || "[]");
        list.push({ id: Date.now(), nama: name, kelas: cls, komitmen: text });
        SafeStorage.setItem("MPLS_COMMITMENTS", JSON.stringify(list));
        return { success: true };
      } else if (funcName === 'deleteCommitment') {
        const [token, id] = args;
        let list = JSON.parse(SafeStorage.getItem("MPLS_COMMITMENTS") || "[]");
        list = list.filter(item => item.id !== id);
        SafeStorage.setItem("MPLS_COMMITMENTS", JSON.stringify(list));
        return { success: true };
      }
      return { success: true };
    }

    // Pemanggilan server GAS cerdas - Menjamin anti-error pada browser client-side
    function gasRun(funcName, ...args) {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const runFallback = () => {
          setTimeout(() => {
            resolve(simulateGasRun(funcName, ...args));
          }, 50);
        };

        if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run) {
          try {
            const runner = google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(function(res) {
                resolve(res);
              })
              .withFailureHandler(function(err) {
                console.warn(`Server GAS untuk ${funcName} bermasalah, beralih ke emulator.`, err);
                runFallback();
              });
            
            if (typeof runner[funcName] === 'function') {
              runner[funcName](...args);
            } else {
              console.warn(`Fungsi server "${funcName}" belum di-deploy di Code.gs. Menggunakan emulator.`);
              runFallback();
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn(`Gagal memanggil google.script.run.${funcName}:`, e);
            runFallback();
          }
        } else {
          runFallback();
        }
      });
    }

    var Auth = {
      getToken: function() { return SafeStorage.getItem("token") || ""; },
      login: function(token) { SafeStorage.setItem("token", token); },
      clear: function() { SafeStorage.removeItem("token"); },
      isVerified: function() {
        return SafeStorage.getItem("sessionType") === 'admin' && !!this.getToken();
      }
    };

    function checkLoginState() {
      const sessionType = SafeStorage.getItem("sessionType");
      if (sessionType === 'admin') {
        toggleElementVisibility('loginPage', false);
        toggleElementVisibility('mainApp', true);
        document.querySelectorAll('.admin-only').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('hidden'));
        showPage('dashboard');
      } else if (sessionType === 'guest') {
        toggleElementVisibility('loginPage', false);
        toggleElementVisibility('mainApp', true);
        document.querySelectorAll('.admin-only').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
        showPage('dashboard');
      } else {
        toggleElementVisibility('mainApp', false);
        toggleElementVisibility('loginPage', true);
      }
    }

    function toggleElementVisibility(id, visible) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return;
      if (visible) {
        el.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (id === 'loginPage' || id === 'mainApp') {
          el.style.setProperty('display', 'flex', 'important');
        } else {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
        }
      } else {
        el.classList.add('hidden');
        el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
      }
    }

    function enterAsGuest() {
      SafeStorage.setItem("sessionType", "guest");
      checkLoginState();
    }
    
    function handleLogin(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const u = document.getElementById("adminUser").value;
      const p = document.getElementById("adminPass").value;
      gasRun('loginUser', u, p).then(function(res) {
        if (res && res.success) {
          SafeStorage.setItem("sessionType", "admin");
          Auth.login(res.token || "session-token-123");
          checkLoginState();
        } else {
          Swal.fire({
            title: "Akses Ditolak",
            text: (res && res.message) ? res.message : "Kombinasi Username/Password salah!",
            icon: "error",
            background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
            color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
          });
        }
      });
    }
    
    function logout() {
      SafeStorage.clear();
      Auth.clear();
      checkLoginState();
    }

    function showPage(pageName) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.app-page').forEach(p => {
        p.classList.add('hidden');
        p.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
      });
      const activePage = document.getElementById('page-' + pageName);
      if (activePage) {
        activePage.classList.remove('hidden');
        activePage.style.setProperty('display', 'block', 'important');
      }
      if (pageName === 'admin-panel') {
        try { populateAdminPanelFields(); } catch(e) { console.error("Error populating admin fields:", e); }
      }
      if (pageName === 'dashboard') {
        try { loadPublicCommitments(); } catch(e) { console.error("Error loading commitments:", e); }
        try { renderGalleryUI(); } catch(e) { console.error("Error rendering gallery:", e); }
        try { renderDownloadsUI(); } catch(e) { console.error("Error rendering downloads:", e); }
      }
    }

    function switchAdminTab(tabId, btn) {
      document.querySelectorAll(".admin-tab-content").forEach(el => el.classList.add("hidden"));
      document.querySelectorAll(".admin-tab-btn").forEach(el => el.classList.remove("active", "bg-white/30", "dark:bg-slate-800/40", "border-white/50", "border"));
      const targetTab = document.getElementById(tabId);
      if (targetTab) {
        targetTab.classList.remove("hidden");
      }
      if (btn) {
        btn.classList.add("active", "bg-white/30", "dark:bg-slate-800/40", "border-white/50", "border");
      }
    }

    function loadSavedConfig() {
      const saved = SafeStorage.getItem("MPLS_CONFIG_V2");
      if (saved) {
        try { 
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved); 
          if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
            AppConfig = parsed;
          }
        } catch (e) { 
          console.error("Gagal memuat konfigurasi lama:", e); 
        }
      }
      
      // Proteksi struktur data agar tidak melempar TypeError
      if (!AppConfig) AppConfig = {};
      if (!AppConfig.downloads) AppConfig.downloads = {};
      for (let key in DocLabels) {
        if (!AppConfig.downloads[key]) {
          AppConfig.downloads[key] = { url: "", fileName: "", fileData: "" };
        } else if (typeof AppConfig.downloads[key] === 'string') {
          AppConfig.downloads[key] = { url: AppConfig.downloads[key], fileName: "", fileData: "" };
        }
      }
      if (!AppConfig.classes) AppConfig.classes = ["Kelas VII-A", "Kelas VII-B", "Kelas VII-C", "Kelas VII-D"];
      if (!AppConfig.gallery) AppConfig.gallery = [];

      applyConfigToUI();
      
      // Sinkronisasi dinamis real-time ke spreadsheet config
      gasRun('getAppConfig').then(function(res) {
        if (res && res.success && res.config) {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(res.config);
            if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
              AppConfig = parsed;
              SafeStorage.setItem("MPLS_CONFIG_V2", res.config);
              applyConfigToUI();
              const adminPage = document.getElementById("page-admin-panel");
              if (adminPage && !adminPage.classList.contains("hidden")) {
                populateAdminPanelFields();
              }
              renderDownloadsUI();
              renderGalleryUI();
            }
          } catch(e) {
            console.error("Gagal mem-parsing konfigurasi dari server:", e);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function saveConfig() {
      SafeStorage.setItem("MPLS_CONFIG_V2", JSON.stringify(AppConfig));
      applyConfigToUI();
      var token = Auth.getToken();
      if (token) {
        gasRun('saveAppConfig', token, JSON.stringify(AppConfig)).catch(console.error);
      }
    }

    function applyConfigToUI() {
      const profileText = document.getElementById("schoolProfileText");
      if (profileText && AppConfig.schoolProfile) profileText.innerText = AppConfig.schoolProfile;

      const totalSiswaText = document.getElementById("totalStudentsText");
      if (totalSiswaText && typeof AppConfig.totalStudents !== 'undefined') {
        totalSiswaText.innerText = AppConfig.totalStudents + " Siswa Baru";
      }

      applyLogoToUI();

      const navSchoolTitle = document.getElementById("navSchoolProfileSub");
      if (navSchoolTitle && AppConfig.schoolProfile) {
        navSchoolTitle.innerText = AppConfig.schoolProfile.substring(0, 30) + "...";
      }

      const loginSchoolTitle = document.getElementById("loginSchoolTitle");
      if (loginSchoolTitle) {
        loginSchoolTitle.innerText = "Sistem Informasi MPLS - Selesai Dikonfigurasi";
      }

      // Display Visi & Misi di Halaman Publik
      const displayVisi = document.getElementById("displayVisi");
      if (displayVisi) displayVisi.innerText = AppConfig.visi || "Belum diatur";

      const displayMisi = document.getElementById("displayMisi");
      if (displayMisi) {
        displayMisi.innerHTML = "";
        if (AppConfig.misi) {
          const list = AppConfig.misi.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim() !== "");
          list.forEach(item => {
            let text = item.trim();
            // Membersihkan numbering bawaan seperti "1.", "- ", dll.
            text = text.replace(/^\d+[\.\-\s]+/, "");
            displayMisi.innerHTML += `<li>${escapeHtml(text)}</li>`;
          });
        } else {
          displayMisi.innerHTML = "<li>Belum diatur</li>";
        }
      }

      // Display Kontak & Maps di Halaman Publik
      const displayAddress = document.getElementById("displayAddress");
      if (displayAddress) displayAddress.innerText = (AppConfig.contact && AppConfig.contact.address) ? AppConfig.contact.address : "Belum diatur";

      const displayEmail = document.getElementById("displayEmail");
      if (displayEmail) displayEmail.innerText = (AppConfig.contact && AppConfig.contact.email) ? AppConfig.contact.email : "Belum diatur";

      const mapContainer = document.getElementById("mapEmbedContainer");
      if (mapContainer) {
        if (AppConfig.mapsUrl) {
          let src = AppConfig.mapsUrl;
          if (src.includes('src="')) {
            src = src.split('src="')[1].split('"')[0];
          }
          mapContainer.innerHTML = `<iframe src="${src}" class="w-full h-full border-0" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"></iframe>`;
        } else {
          mapContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-semibold p-4 text-center"><i class="fa-solid fa-map text-lg mb-1 block"></i> Peta lokasi belum disematkan</div>`;
        }
      }
    }

    function applyLogoToUI() {
      const imgElements = [
        { containerId: "loginLogoPreviewContainer" },
        { containerId: "navLogoPreviewContainer" },
        { containerId: "adminLogoPreview" }
      ];

      imgElements.forEach(item => {
        const container = document.getElementById(item.containerId);
        if (!container) return;

        if (AppConfig.logo) {
          container.innerHTML = `<img src="${AppConfig.logo}" class="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-xl" alt="Logo">`;
        } else {
          container.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-graduation-cap text-3xl text-brand-500"></i>`;
        }
      });
    }

    function handleLogoUpload(input) {
      if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
          AppConfig.logo = e.target.result;
          saveConfig();
          applyLogoToUI();
          Swal.fire({
            title: "Logo Diunggah",
            text: "Logo sekolah berhasil disimpan dan diperbarui di semua halaman.",
            icon: "success",
            background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
            color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
          });
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(input.files[0]);
      }
    }

    function populateAdminPanelFields() {
      try {
        const profileInput = document.getElementById("adminInputProfile");
        if (profileInput) profileInput.value = AppConfig.schoolProfile || "";
      } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

      try {
        const visiInput = document.getElementById("adminInputVisi");
        if (visiInput) visiInput.value = AppConfig.visi || "";
      } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

      try {
        const misiInput = document.getElementById("adminInputMisi");
        if (misiInput) misiInput.value = AppConfig.misi || "";
      } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

      try {
        const addressInput = document.getElementById("adminInputAddress");
        if (addressInput) addressInput.value = (AppConfig.contact && AppConfig.contact.address) ? AppConfig.contact.address : "";
      } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

      try {
        const emailInput = document.getElementById("adminInputEmail");
        if (emailInput) emailInput.value = (AppConfig.contact && AppConfig.contact.email) ? AppConfig.contact.email : "";
      } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

      try {
        const mapInput = document.getElementById("adminInputMapUrl");
        if (mapInput) mapInput.value = AppConfig.mapsUrl || "";
      } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

      try {
        const totalSiswaInput = document.getElementById("adminInputTotalSiswa");
        if (totalSiswaInput) totalSiswaInput.value = AppConfig.totalStudents || 0;
      } catch(e) { console.error(e); }

      try { renderAdminKelasList(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
      try { renderAdminCloudDocumentsList(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
      try { renderAdminGalleryList(); } catch(e) { console.error(e); }
    }

    function handleSaveSchoolInfo(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      AppConfig.schoolProfile = document.getElementById("adminInputProfile").value;
      AppConfig.visi = document.getElementById("adminInputVisi").value;
      AppConfig.misi = document.getElementById("adminInputMisi").value;
      if (!AppConfig.contact) AppConfig.contact = {};
      AppConfig.contact.address = document.getElementById("adminInputAddress").value;
      AppConfig.contact.email = document.getElementById("adminInputEmail").value;
      AppConfig.mapsUrl = document.getElementById("adminInputMapUrl").value;
      saveConfig();
      Swal.fire({
        title: "Sukses",
        text: "Data profil sekolah berhasil disimpan.",
        icon: "success",
        background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
        color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
      });
    }

    function handleSaveSiswaKelas(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      AppConfig.totalStudents = parseInt(document.getElementById("adminInputTotalSiswa").value) || 0;
      saveConfig();
      Swal.fire({
        title: "Berhasil",
        text: "Jumlah siswa baru berhasil disinkronkan.",
        icon: "success",
        background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
        color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
      });
    }

    function renderAdminKelasList() {
      const c = document.getElementById("adminKelasListContainer");
      if (c) {
        c.innerHTML = AppConfig.classes.map((cls, i) => `
          <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white/40 dark:bg-slate-800/40 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold border border-white/40">
            ${cls}
            <button type="button" onclick="handleRemoveKelas(${i})" class="text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 font-bold ml-1 text-sm cursor-pointer">&times;</button>
          </span>
        `).join('');
      }
    }

    function handleAddKelas() {
      const input = document.getElementById("adminNewKelasInput");
      if (input && input.value.trim() !== "") {
        AppConfig.classes.push(input.value.trim());
        input.value = "";
        saveConfig();
        renderAdminKelasList();
        renderCommitmentFormSelect();
      }
    }

    function handleRemoveKelas(i) {
      AppConfig.classes.splice(i, 1);
      saveConfig();
      renderAdminKelasList();
      renderCommitmentFormSelect();
    }

    function renderCommitmentFormSelect() {
      const select = document.getElementById('commitClass');
      if (select) {
        select.innerHTML = AppConfig.classes.map(cls => `<option class="text-slate-900" value="${cls}">${cls}</option>`).join('');
      }
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
      if (!str) return '';
      return String(str)
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
    }

    function renderAdminCloudDocumentsList() {
      const container = document.getElementById("adminCloudDocumentsGrid");
      if (!container) return;

      let html = "";
      for (let key in DocLabels) {
        const doc = AppConfig.downloads[key] || { url: "", fileName: "", fileData: "" };
        const labelInfo = DocLabels[key];

        const safeLabel = escapeHtml(labelInfo.label || 'Unduhan');
        const safeUrl = escapeHtml(doc.url || '');
        const safeFileName = escapeHtml(doc.fileName || '');

        const hasLocalFile = doc.fileData ? true : false;
        const statusText = hasLocalFile ? 
          `<span class="text-xs text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-check"></i> Lokal: ${safeFileName}</span>` : 
          `<span class="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium italic flex items-center gap-1.5"><i class="fa-regular fa-circle-xmark"></i> Belum ada file lokal</span>`;

        html += `
          <div class="p-5 bg-white/25 dark:bg-slate-900/35 rounded-2xl border border-white/40 dark:border-white/10 flex flex-col xl:flex-row items-stretch xl:items-center justify-between gap-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition duration-300">
            <!-- Label & Info Section -->
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-2">
              <span class="block font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">${safeLabel}</span>
              <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1.5 flex-wrap">
                ${statusText}
                <span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium truncate max-w-xs sm:max-w-md">
                  Link Cloud: ${safeUrl ? `<a href="${safeUrl}" target="_blank" class="text-brand-500 dark:text-brand-400 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1">${safeUrl} <i class="fa-solid fa-up-right-from-square text-[8px]"></i></a>` : '<span class="italic text-slate-400">Belum diatur</span>'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <!-- Action Inputs Section -->
            <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 items-stretch sm:items-center w-full xl:w-auto">
              <!-- File Upload Input Box -->
              <div class="flex flex-col gap-1 w-full sm:w-56">
                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Unggah File Lokal</span>
                <input type="file" onchange="handleDocFileUpload('${key}', this)" class="block w-full text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 file:mr-2 file:py-1.5 file:px-3 file:rounded-xl file:border-0 file:text-[10px] file:font-bold file:bg-brand-500/20 file:text-brand-700 dark:file:text-brand-300 hover:file:bg-brand-500/35 cursor-pointer">
              </div>
              
              <!-- Cloud URL Input Box -->
              <div class="flex flex-col gap-1 w-full sm:w-64">
                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Tautkan URL Cloud</span>
                <input type="text" placeholder="https://drive.google.com/..." value="${safeUrl}" onchange="setDocUrl('${key}', this.value)" class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs rounded-xl glass-input text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500/50">
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }
      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function handleDocFileUpload(docKey, input) {
      if (input.files && input.files[0]) {
        const file = input.files[0];
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
          try {
            AppConfig.downloads[docKey] = {
              url: AppConfig.downloads[docKey]?.url || "",
              fileName: file.name,
              fileData: e.target.result
            };
            saveConfig();
            renderAdminCloudDocumentsList();
            renderDownloadsUI();
            Swal.fire({
              title: "Berhasil Diunggah!",
              text: `Berkas ${file.name} sekarang terunggah secara lokal.`,
              icon: "success",
              background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
              color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
            });
          } catch(err) {
            Swal.fire({
              title: "Storage Penuh",
              text: "Gagal menyimpan berkas lokal karena keterbatasan memori peramban. Sangat disarankan untuk menempelkan tautan rujukan Google Drive Anda.",
              icon: "warning",
              background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
              color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
            });
          }
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      }
    }

    function setDocUrl(key, val) {
      if (!AppConfig.downloads[key]) {
        AppConfig.downloads[key] = { url: "", fileName: "", fileData: "" };
      }
      AppConfig.downloads[key].url = val;
      saveConfig();
      renderAdminCloudDocumentsList();
      renderDownloadsUI();
    }

    function renderDownloadsUI() {
      const container = document.getElementById("downloadsContainer");
      if (!container) return;

      let html = "";
      for (let key in DocLabels) {
        const labelInfo = DocLabels[key];
        const doc = (AppConfig && AppConfig.downloads && AppConfig.downloads[key]) || { url: "", fileName: "", fileData: "" };

        html += `
          <div class="glass-card p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-xl flex flex-col justify-between text-center min-h-[225px] transition hover:scale-105 duration-300">
            <div class="w-10 h-10 ${labelInfo.color || 'text-brand-500 bg-brand-500/20'} rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-base mx-auto mb-2 shadow-inner"><i class="fa-solid ${labelInfo.icon || 'fa-file'}"></i></div>
            <div>
              <h4 class="font-bold text-xs text-slate-950 dark:text-white line-clamp-2">${labelInfo.label || 'Unduhan'}</h4>
              <span class="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold block mt-1 mb-3">${labelInfo.subtitle || ''}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="space-y-1 mt-auto">
              <button onclick="handlePreviewDoc('${key}')" class="w-full py-1.5 bg-white/40 dark:bg-slate-700/40 hover:bg-white/60 text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-[10px] font-bold rounded-xl transition border border-white/30 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-sm cursor-pointer"><i class="fa-solid fa-eye"></i> Pratinjau</button>
              <button onclick="handleDocDownload('${key}')" class="w-full py-1.5 bg-brand-500/80 hover:bg-brand-600 text-white text-[10px] font-bold rounded-xl transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow cursor-pointer"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-down-long"></i> Unduh</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }
      container.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function handlePreviewDoc(docKey) {
      const doc = (AppConfig && AppConfig.downloads && AppConfig.downloads[docKey]) || { url: "", fileName: "", fileData: "" };
      const labelInfo = DocLabels[docKey];
      const title = labelInfo ? labelInfo.label : "Pratinjau Dokumen";

      document.getElementById("previewModalTitle").innerText = title;
      const body = document.getElementById("previewModalBody");
      if (!body) return;

      const dlBtn = document.getElementById("previewModalDownloadBtn");
      if (dlBtn) {
        dlBtn.onclick = function() { handleDocDownload(docKey); };
      }

      if (doc.fileData) {
        if (doc.fileData.startsWith("data:image/")) {
          body.innerHTML = `<img src="${doc.fileData}" class="max-h-[60vh] rounded-xl object-contain shadow-md" alt="${doc.fileName}">`;
        } else if (doc.fileData.startsWith("data:application/pdf")) {
          body.innerHTML = `<iframe src="${doc.fileData}" class="w-full h-[60vh] rounded-2xl border border-white/20 shadow-inner"></iframe>`;
        } else {
          body.innerHTML = `
            <div class="text-center p-6 bg-white/20 rounded-2xl border border-white/30">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines text-5xl text-brand-500 mb-3 animate-pulse"></i>
              <h4 class="font-bold text-sm">${doc.fileName}</h4>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">Format dokumen tidak didukung langsung oleh pratinjau browser, harap unduh secara langsung.</p>
            </div>`;
        }
      } else if (doc.url && doc.url.startsWith("http")) {
        let embed = doc.url;
        if (doc.url.includes("drive.google.com") && doc.url.includes("id=")) {
          const id = doc.url.split("id=")[1].split("&")[0];
          embed = "https://drive.google.com/file/d/" + id + "/preview";
        } else if (doc.url.includes("drive.google.com/file/d/")) {
          const parts = doc.url.split("/file/d/");
          if (parts.length > 1) {
            const id = parts[1].split("/")[0];
            embed = "https://drive.google.com/file/d/" + id + "/preview";
          }
        }
        body.innerHTML = `<iframe src="${embed}" class="w-full h-[60vh] rounded-2xl border border-white/20 shadow-inner"></iframe>`;
      } else {
        body.innerHTML = getMockPreviewHTML(docKey);
      }

      const modal = document.getElementById("previewModal");
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove("hidden");
        modal.classList.add("flex");
      }
    }

    function handleDocDownload(docKey) {
      const doc = (AppConfig && AppConfig.downloads && AppConfig.downloads[docKey]) || { url: "", fileName: "", fileData: "" };
      
      if (doc.fileData) {
        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = doc.fileData;
        a.download = doc.fileName || `${docKey}_MPLS.pdf`;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
      } else if (doc.url && doc.url.startsWith("http")) {
        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = doc.url;
        a.target = "_blank";
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
      } else {
        Swal.fire({
          title: "Informasi Dokumen",
          text: "Gunakan Panel Admin untuk mengunggah berkas lokal atau menempelkan rujukan link cloud Anda. Saat ini pratinjau simulasi aktif.",
          icon: "info",
          background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
          color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
        });
      }
    }

    function closePreviewDoc() {
      const modal = document.getElementById("previewModal");
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.add("hidden");
        modal.classList.remove("flex");
      }
    }

    function renderAdminGalleryList() {
      const container = document.getElementById("adminGalleryManagementList");
      if (!container) return;

      if (!AppConfig || !AppConfig.gallery || AppConfig.gallery.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<p class="col-span-full text-xs text-slate-500 italic text-center">Belum ada foto galeri.</p>`;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = AppConfig.gallery.map((img, i) => {
        if (!img) return '';
        return `
          <div class="bg-white/20 dark:bg-slate-950/20 rounded-2xl border border-white/40 p-3 flex flex-col justify-between shadow-sm">
            <div class="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden aspect-video bg-black/10">
              <img src="${img.src || ''}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" alt="Galeri">
            </div>
            <p class="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 line-clamp-2 mt-2 leading-snug">${img.caption || ''}</p>
            <button type="button" onclick="handleRemoveGalleryItem(${i})" class="mt-3 w-full py-1.5 bg-rose-500/20 hover:bg-rose-500/35 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-bold text-[10px] rounded-lg transition border border-white/20 cursor-pointer"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash mr-1"></i> Hapus Foto</button>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function handleGalleryUploadSubmit(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const fileInput = document.getElementById("galleryInputFile");
      const captionInput = document.getElementById("galleryInputCaption");

      if (fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0]) {
        const file = fileInput.files[0];
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(event) {
          try {
            if (!AppConfig.gallery) AppConfig.gallery = [];
            AppConfig.gallery.push({
              src: event.target.result,
              caption: captionInput.value
            });
            saveConfig();
            renderAdminGalleryList();
            renderGalleryUI();
            
            fileInput.value = "";
            captionInput.value = "";
            
            Swal.fire({
              title: "Ditambahkan!",
              text: "Foto kegiatan berhasil dipublikasikan ke galeri utama.",
              icon: "success",
              background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
              color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
            });
          } catch(err) {
            Swal.fire({
              title: "Limit Penyimpanan",
              text: "Berkas gambar yang Anda unggah terlalu besar. Silakan kompres gambar terlebih dahulu sebelum diunggah.",
              icon: "warning",
              background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
              color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
            });
          }
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      }
    }

    function handleRemoveGalleryItem(index) {
      if (AppConfig && AppConfig.gallery) {
        AppConfig.gallery.splice(index, 1);
        saveConfig();
        renderAdminGalleryList();
        renderGalleryUI();
      }
    }

    function renderGalleryUI() {
      const container = document.getElementById("galleryDisplayGrid");
      if (!container) return;

      if (!AppConfig || !AppConfig.gallery || AppConfig.gallery.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `<p class="col-span-full text-xs text-slate-500 italic text-center">Belum ada dokumentasi momen.</p>`;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = AppConfig.gallery.map(img => {
        if (!img || !img.src) return '';
        const safeCaption = String(img.caption || 'Foto Kegiatan').replace(/'/g, "\\'");
        return `
          <div class="group overflow-hidden rounded-2xl cursor-pointer shadow-xl relative glass-card" onclick="openLightbox('${img.src}', '${safeCaption}')">
            <img src="${img.src}" alt="Galeri" class="w-full h-48 object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition duration-500">
            <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition duration-300 flex items-center justify-center"><i class="fa-solid fa-magnifying-glass-plus text-white text-2xl"></i></div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function loadPublicCommitments() {
      gasRun('getPublicCommitments').then(function(res) {
        const container = document.getElementById('treeContainer');
        if (!container) return;
        container.innerHTML = "";

        const leafCounter = document.getElementById('leafCounter');
        if (leafCounter) {
          leafCounter.innerText = (res && res.data ? res.data.length : 0) + ' Komitmen';
        }

        if (!res || !res.data || !Array.isArray(res.data) || res.data.length === 0) {
          container.innerHTML = `<div class="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium p-4 text-center w-full">Belum ada komitmen siswa. Jadilah yang pertama menanam komitmen!</div>`;
          return;
        }

        res.data.forEach(item => {
          if (item) {
            const rawName = item.nama || item.name || "Siswa";
            const rawClass = item.kelas || item.class || "VII";
            const rawText = item.komitmen || item.text || "";

            const cleanName = String(rawName).split(' ')[0] || "Siswa";
            const cleanClass = String(rawClass).replace("Kelas ", "") || "VII";
            const cleanCommitment = String(rawText).replace(/'/g, "\\'");
            
            container.innerHTML += `
              <button class="bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-[11px] font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full shadow-md transition flex items-center gap-1.5 border border-white/30 backdrop-blur-sm cursor-pointer" onclick="Swal.fire({title: 'Komitmen Belajar ${cleanName}', text: '${cleanCommitment}', icon: 'info', background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff', color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'})">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-leaf text-emerald-400 dark:text-emerald-300"></i> ${cleanName} (${cleanClass})
              </button>`;
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function handleCommitmentSubmit(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const name = document.getElementById('commitName').value;
      const cls = document.getElementById('commitClass').value;
      const text = document.getElementById('commitText').value;
      gasRun('addCommitmentPublic', name, cls, text).then(function() {
        if (typeof confetti !== 'undefined') {
          confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 70, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
        }
        Swal.fire({
          title: "Terima Kasih!",
          text: "Komitmen belajarmu berhasil digantungkan di pohon digital!",
          icon: "success",
          background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
          color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
        });
        document.getElementById('commitName').value = "";
        document.getElementById('commitText').value = "";
        loadPublicCommitments();
      });
    }

    function loadAdminCommitments() {
      const container = document.getElementById('adminCommitmentsContainer');
      if (!container) return;
      container.innerHTML = "<p class='text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold'>Menghubungkan ke basis cloud...</p>";
      
      const token = Auth.getToken();
      gasRun('getCommitments', token).then(function(res) {
        if (res && res.success && Array.isArray(res.data)) {
          if (res.data.length === 0) {
            container.innerHTML = `<p class="text-xs text-slate-400">Tidak ada komitmen siswa untuk dimoderasi.</p>`;
            return;
          }
          let html = `
            <table class="w-full border-collapse text-left text-xs bg-white/20 dark:bg-slate-900/20 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-white/30">
              <thead>
                <tr class="bg-white/40 dark:bg-slate-800/40 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border-b border-white/30 font-bold">
                  <th class="p-3">Nama</th>
                  <th class="p-3">Kelas</th>
                  <th class="p-3">Komitmen</th>
                  <th class="p-3 text-center border-l border-white/30">Aksi</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>`;
          res.data.forEach(item => {
            const rawName = item.nama || item.name || "-";
            const rawClass = item.kelas || item.class || "-";
            const rawText = item.komitmen || item.text || "-";
            const itemId = item.id || 0;

            html += `
              <tr class="border-b border-white/20 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold">
                <td class="p-3 font-bold">${rawName}</td>
                <td class="p-3">${rawClass}</td>
                <td class="p-3 max-w-xs truncate">${rawText}</td>
                <td class="p-3 text-center border-l border-white/20">
                  <button onclick="deleteCommitmentItem(${itemId})" class="text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 hover:underline font-bold cursor-pointer"><i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"></i> Hapus</button>
                </td>
              </tr>`;
          });
          container.innerHTML = html + "</tbody></table>";
        } else {
          container.innerHTML = `<p class="text-xs text-rose-500 font-semibold">Gagal memuat data komitmen: ${res && res.message ? res.message : 'Sesi tidak valid'}</p>`;
        }
      });
    }

    window.deleteCommitmentItem = function(id) {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Apakah Anda yakin?',
        text: "Komitmen ini akan dihapus permanen dari database cloud!",
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonColor: '#ef4444',
        cancelButtonColor: '#3b82f6',
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Hapus!',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal',
        background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
        color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
      }).then((result) => {
        if (result.isConfirmed) {
          gasRun('deleteCommitment', Auth.getToken(), id).then(function(res) {
            if (res && res.success) {
              Swal.fire({
                title: 'Terhapus!',
                text: 'Komitmen berhasil dihapus.',
                icon: 'success',
                background: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#1e293b' : '#fff',
                color: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? '#fff' : '#000'
              });
              loadAdminCommitments();
              loadPublicCommitments();
            } else {
              Swal.fire('Gagal', res && res.message ? res.message : 'Gagal menghapus komitmen.', 'error');
            }
          });
        }
      });
    };

    var quizAnswers = { 1: '', 2: '', 3: '' };

    function selectAnswer(step, ans) {
      quizAnswers[step] = ans;
      document.getElementById('quiz-step-' + step).classList.add('hidden');
      if (step < 3) {
        document.getElementById('quiz-step-' + (step + 1)).classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        calculateQuizResult();
      }
    }

    function calculateQuizResult() {
      let counts = { A: 0, B: 0, C: 0 };
      counts[quizAnswers[1]]++;
      counts[quizAnswers[2]]++;
      counts[quizAnswers[3]]++;

      let style = 'VISUAL';
      let desc = 'Anda sangat mudah menyerap informasi melalui gambar, grafik, diagram, peta konsep, atau video pembelajaran.';
      
      if (counts.A >= counts.B && counts.A >= counts.C) {
        style = 'AUDITORI';
        desc = 'Anda paling nyaman belajar dengan mendengarkan penjelasan lisan dari guru, rekaman audio, lagu pembelajaran, atau diskusi lisan kawan.';
      } else if (counts.C >= counts.A && counts.C >= counts.B) {
        style = 'KINESTETIK';
        desc = 'Anda aktif bergerak! Anda lebih mudah mengerti materi jika mempraktikkannya langsung, menyentuh model fisik, atau melakukan eksperimen sederhana.';
      }

      document.getElementById('styleResultType').innerText = style;
      document.getElementById('styleResultDesc').innerText = desc;
      document.getElementById('quiz-result').classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function restartQuiz() {
      quizAnswers = { 1: '', 2: '', 3: '' };
      document.getElementById('quiz-result').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('quiz-step-1').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('quiz-step-2').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('quiz-step-3').classList.add('hidden');
    }

    function openLightbox(src, caption) {
      document.getElementById('lightboxImg').src = src;
      document.getElementById('lightboxCaption').innerText = caption;
      document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('flex');
    }

    function closeLightbox() {
      document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('lightbox').classList.remove('flex');
    }

    function toggleDarkMode() {
      document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
    }

    function scrollToSection(id) {
      const target = document.getElementById(id);
      if (target) {
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }

    // Eksekusi inisialisasi dokumen berpelindung isolasi try-catch terperinci
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
      try { loadSavedConfig(); } catch (e) { console.error("Error loadSavedConfig:", e); }
      try { checkLoginState(); } catch (e) { console.error("Error checkLoginState:", e); }
      try { loadPublicCommitments(); } catch (e) { console.error("Error loadPublicCommitments:", e); }
      try { renderDownloadsUI(); } catch (e) { console.error("Error renderDownloadsUI:", e); }
      try { renderGalleryUI(); } catch (e) { console.error("Error renderGalleryUI:", e); }
      try { renderCommitmentFormSelect(); } catch (e) { console.error("Error renderCommitmentFormSelect:", e); }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
